overview_description.description:
Perfect Vision is a smart, high-tech factory that focuses on developing and manufacturing innovative solutions using the latest technologies of the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR). These solutions are based on Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT), IoT, AI, robotics, machine learning, big data, analytics, and immersive technology. The company operates in key industries such as AI, Construction, Electronics, Oil, and Gas, continuously growing to meet the demands of projects within Saudi Arabia.

Mission:

Safety: Ensuring secure environments.
Collaboration: Working together with stakeholders.
Agility: Adapting quickly to change.
Diversity: Valuing different perspectives.
Ethics: Committing to ethical standards.
Vision: Leverage path-breaking technologies and operational excellence to deliver cutting-edge solutions that transform lives, advance human progress, and protect nature.

about_short_description.short_description: 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗲𝗰𝘁 𝗩𝗶𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻 manufactures and develops various IoT systems, especially for safety and logistics.

identifier.value: Automatic Fire Suppression System for Heavy Vehicle

product.name: Automatic Fire Suppression System for Heavy Vehicle
product.description: An automatic system designed to detect and suppress fires in heavy vehicles and industrial machinery using non-conductive extinguishing agents.

product.name: Boom Truck Load Moment Indicator (LMI)
product.description: A safety device for boom trucks that monitors load weight and boom position to prevent overloading and tipping during lifting operations.

product.name: Excavator Load Moment Indicator (LMI)
product.description: A device installed on excavators to monitor load weight, boom angle, and machine stability, providing alerts to prevent overloading and tipping.

identifier.value: Forklift Proximity Warning Alert System (Forklift PWAS)

product.name: Forklift Proximity Warning Alert System (Forklift PWAS)
product.description: A safety system for forklifts that detects nearby personnel and objects, providing visual and audible warnings to prevent collisions in busy work environments.

product.name: Proximity Warning Alert System (PWAS)
product.description: A sensor-based safety system for worksites that detects proximity between vehicles and personnel, issuing alerts to prevent accidents.

identifier.value: Tag-Based Proximity Warning Alert System (Tag PWAS)

product.name: Tag-Based Proximity Warning Alert System (Tag PWAS)
product.description: A vehicle safety system that detects personnel and objects wearing tags within a 7-15 meter range, providing alerts to prevent collisions and blind spot accidents.
